confidence_notes: Holistic model estimates from general knowledge of Boston pricing, not checked against live menus, listings, or booking pages. Restaurant and drink anchors are more reliable than accommodation, which depends on July peak-season demand and is the least certain. Cocktail and wine are estimated from general knowledge of Boston bar pricing, not from the beer anchor. The FX value comes from one search snippet of the RBA exchange-rates page; the snippet also showed older cached dates, so the value was not independently confirmed on the live page.
comparable_city_reasoning: Regional basis: large US Northeast metro with high restaurant, bar, and lodging costs. Benchmarked against general knowledge of comparable US East Coast cities such as New York and Washington, DC, adjusted for Boston's typical price levels in summer 2026. No live listings were consulted.
